messages.author: e4181d5c40fc094c
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Output of DMR regions in a text format via methyKit or eDMR
parts:
Dear dave,

In case you are asking about saving a R object of GRanges class (In this case myDMR2 as explained by Sheng) into a text file you can do the following:

Option 1:
# You should have installed rtracklayer library
# This option will write a bed formatted file of the dmrs
# Remember that this option doesnt write any of the metadata
# Check the help for exact command usage for export.bed

library(rtracklayer)
>export.bed(myDMR2,"my_dmr2.bed")

Option2:
# Simply write the GRanges object/myDMR2 into a text file
# Check help for exact command usage
#This option writes every column into the text file separated by single space

> my_dmr2=as.data.frame(myDMR2)
>write.table(my_dmr2, file="my_dmr2.txt", quote=F, row.names=F)


Regards,
Kalyan

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Output of DMR regions in a text format via methyKit or eDMR
parts:
Hi Dave,

Try this?

getGR=function(myDMR, subject){
  ind=findOverlaps(subject,myDMR)
  subject[unique(ind@queryHits)]
}

# genebody promoters
gr=getGR(myDMR, genebody$promoter)
gr2=as.data.frame(gr)
write.table(gr2, file="gr2.txt", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=F)

# CpG island:
CpGi.gr=getGR(myDMR, cpgi$cpgis)
CpGi.gr2=as.data.frame(CpGi.gr)
write.table(gr2, file="CpGigr2.txt", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=F)

Cheers,
Sheng

parts: Thanks Sheng - I'll give it a try. Dave

On Thursday, February 20, 2014 3:43:22 PM UTC-6, Sheng Li wrote:
Hi Dave,

Try this?

getGR=function(myDMR, subject){
  ind=findOverlaps(subject,myDMR)
  subject[unique(ind@queryHits)]
}

# genebody promoters
gr=getGR(myDMR, genebody$promoter)
gr2=as.data.frame(gr)
write.table(gr2, file="gr2.txt", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=F)

# CpG island:
CpGi.gr=getGR(myDMR, cpgi$cpgis)
CpGi.gr2=as.data.frame(CpGi.gr)
write.table(gr2, file="CpGigr2.txt", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=F)

Cheers,
Sheng

On Thursday, February 20, 2014 2:32:37 PM UTC-6, Kalyan Kumar Pasumarthy wrote:
Dear dave,

In case you are asking about saving a R object of GRanges class (In this case myDMR2 as explained by Sheng) into a text file you can do the following:

Option 1:
# You should have installed rtracklayer library
# This option will write a bed formatted file of the dmrs
# Remember that this option doesnt write any of the metadata
# Check the help for exact command usage for export.bed

library(rtracklayer)
>export.bed(myDMR2,"my_dmr2.bed")

Option2:
# Simply write the GRanges object/myDMR2 into a text file
# Check help for exact command usage
#This option writes every column into the text file separated by single space

> my_dmr2=as.data.frame(myDMR2)
>write.table(my_dmr2, file="my_dmr2.txt", quote=F, row.names=F)


Regards,
Kalyan
